body: Seems to me that this happened between [v13.4.20-canary.23...v13.4.20-canary.24](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/compare/v13.4.20-canary.23...v13.4.20-canary.24). https://github.com/vercel/next.js/commit/7d93808c435d6d74f93e045711b1639dc1fc05b3 looks suspicious.

issue.title: test: ability to use node debugger
issue.body:
Fixes ability to run `NODE_OPTIONS='--inspect' next dev` as described in [docs](https://nextjs.org/docs/pages/building-your-application/configuring/debugging), by removing inspect option from NODE_OPTIONS arg passed to worker process.

This bug seem to have been introduced in 7d93808c435d6d74f93e045711b1639dc1fc05b3 as a part of a some refactoring. See how `getNodeOptionsWithoutInspect` is no longer used.

Fixes #55862

issue.title: misc: fix injecting --inspect with NODE_OPTIONS
issue.body:
This PR fixes the passing of the `--inspect` option when calling Next.js with it. It's still not great because you need to target the next file in node_modules directly but I'll add a `next --inspect` option in the future.
